item.title: Fort Huachuca disbands ceremonial cavalry unit
item.description: Fort Huchuca is proud of its history and its role in frontier Arizona, including the role of the horse soldiers in that period. But now a special unit that honors that history is being disbanded.

item.title: ICE shows interest in using former prison in Marana as detention facility
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement has posted a notice of its intent to award a sole-source contract to Management and Training Corporation to operate the former state prison in Marana.

item.title: Sydney's Sweet Shoppe brings in new treats with new Northside Location
item.description: Sydney's Sweet Shoppe, the Tucson-favorite local bakery and Black-owned business, is expanding to a new location at Oracle and Ina Road, serving the treats Tucson already knows and loves.
